finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| file | bug | fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | treat unset as `false` |

The 8 warnings are still there. They are deprecation notices printed by `fakepack` itself. Your source cannot silence them.

Next: fix the deprecated calls in `src/legacy/` if you want a clean log.
